title: The Salt of the Glass Steppe
premise: Silas Kavanagh keeps the ledgers of the Glass Steppe Guild, a trade house that deals in stolen memories, bottled names, and other impossible things, while hiding their own gift: the ability to lift a memory with a touch. When the crown declares the Thirteenth Hunt, ordering every gifted person branded or burned, Silas's carefully invisible life collapses as the guild's own records become the hunters' map. To survive, Silas must ally with Vespera, a disgraced royal cartographer who knows the way through the Door of Salt—the only exit from a country whose borders were erased from every official map a century ago. As the moon completes its thirteenth turn, Silas must choose between destroying the ledgers to free thousands of stolen memories and keeping them to buy their own passage, ultimately burning the archive, opening the Door for all the hunted, and stepping into the unmapped country beyond with Vespera at their side.
about_author: Wren Okonkwo is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing confiscated letters in a coastal customs house before turning to fiction. They write about borders, memory, and the people history files under 'miscellaneous,' and live somewhere between two time zones.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Small Thefts
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. A night of routine work: recording the guild's latest acquisitions—a soldier's courage, a widow's grief—while concealing their own gift from the guildmaster. Establishes the ledger room, the rules, and Silas's loneliness. Emotional beat: quiet dread beneath competence.

chapters.title: Thirteenth Moon Rising
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. In the capital, the royal cartographer discovers the proclamation of the Thirteenth Hunt hidden inside an atlas she is redrawing. She realizes her own sister bears the gift. Emotional beat: the moment loyalty to the crown cracks.

chapters.title: What the Guild Buys
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. A client trades away the memory of his daughter's face to pay a debt; Silas secretly returns a fragment by touch and feels his joy as their own. First hint that Silas cannot stay neutral. Emotional beat: guilt sharpening into purpose.

chapters.title: The Proclamation
chapters.summary: Guildmaster Corvane's POV. He reads the hunt decree and begins quietly selling the guild's records of gifted clients to the crown—betrayal dressed as survival. Silas notices a page missing. Emotional beat: cold realization that home is a trap.

chapters.title: A Cartographer's Confession
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. She burns her sister's name from the census rolls and flees the capital with a stolen map fragment showing the Door of Salt. Pursued, she heads for the Steppe, where rumor says the guild buys anything. Emotional beat: terror braided with resolve.

chapters.title: The Woman Who Sold Her Way In
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Vespera arrives offering the map fragment as payment. Silas recognizes the erased country on it—the Salt Steppe, their grandmother's homeland. They strike a secret bargain behind Corvane's back. Emotional beat: wary magnetism between two liars.

chapters.title: Ink That Remembers
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. Working in the guild's archive, she finds maps drawn in memory-ink that shift when touched. Silas's accidental brush of skin shows her a stolen childhood—hers, sold years ago. Emotional beat: intimacy through violation, forgiveness beginning anyway.

chapters.title: Corvane's Price
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Corvane reveals he knows about the bargain and offers Silas a choice: deliver Vespera to the hunters and inherit the guild, or be named in the ledgers as gifted. Emotional beat: the noose tightening; duty weaponized.

chapters.title: The First Branding
chapters.summary: Tavern-keeper Odile's POV. A neighbor is publicly branded in the Steppe market square while the crowd looks away. Odile shelters a gifted child afterward, showing how ordinary people choose. Emotional beat: communal fear curdling into small defiance.

chapters.title: Ledger Burning, Page One
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Silas secretly copies the ledger of the hunted, planning to warn them, and touches each name, carrying fragments of strangers' lives. The weight of borrowed grief nearly breaks them. Emotional beat: compassion as burden.

chapters.title: The Hunter with a Gentle Voice
chapters.summary: Warden Ilsette's POV. The crown's chief hunter interviews Corvane, courteous and merciless. She suspects the guild itself is riddled with the gift and sets a test: a false client bearing a baited memory. Emotional beat: patient menace.

chapters.title: Baited Memory
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Silas takes the baited memory during a routine appraisal and instantly knows it's a trap—but touching it means the Warden can now trace them. They must vanish from the guild that same night. Emotional beat: adrenaline and heartbreak at leaving the only home they knew.

chapters.title: Salt on the Wind
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. She and Silas flee across the glass flats by night, navigating by the thirteenth moon's strange double shadow. First honest conversation about what they've each betrayed. Emotional beat: two fugitives becoming accomplices.

chapters.title: The Child Who Remembered Everything
chapters.summary: Odile's POV again. The gifted child, Neme, is taken by hunters; Odile rides after them and sends word to Silas via smuggler channels. Emotional beat: love outside law, the cost of kindness.

chapters.title: Smugglers' Liturgy
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Among salt-smugglers, Silas learns the old rites of the erased country—songs that are actually navigation instructions. Their grandmother's lullaby turns out to be a map. Emotional beat: heritage returning like a tide.

chapters.title: Ilsette Closes the Net
chapters.summary: Warden Ilsette's POV. She brands Corvane when she catches him falsifying records, then uses him as a hound to track Silas. Her own backstory surfaces: a brother she reported, long ago. Emotional beat: the hunter's wound.

chapters.title: Rescue at the Weigh Station
chapters.summary: Alternating Silas/Vespera POV. A raid on a hunter weigh station frees Neme and other captives; Silas touches a captive's brand and absorbs the pain of it, revealing their gift publicly for the first time. Emotional beat: heroism with a price.

chapters.title: Known Now
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. With Silas exposed, the fugitive network must decide whether to trust them. Vespera vouches with her own name and rank, formally renouncing the crown. Emotional beat: identity chosen, not assigned.

chapters.title: The Ledger of the Hunted
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Silas distributes copies of the hunted-names ledger across the network so no one can be disappeared silently. Some recipients rage at being remembered; one thanks them with a memory freely given. Emotional beat: justice outside the law taking shape.

chapters.title: Moon Twelve
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. Astronomical reckoning: one turn remains before the Door of Salt seals for another century. But the Door opens only for those who carry a true memory of the country—and most refugees were born after its erasure. Emotional beat: hope undercut by arithmetic.

chapters.title: What Corvane Sells Next
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. Broken and branded, he bargains with Ilsette: the Door's location in exchange for restoration. His self-justifications crumble as he admits he erased his own memories of why he built the guild. Emotional beat: tragedy of a man who traded his past for power.

chapters.title: The Memory Market Riot
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Hunters raid the Steppe's memory market; freed memories scatter like moths, and citizens suddenly recall the erased country in flashes. The crowd turns on the hunters. Emotional beat: collective remembering as uprising.

chapters.title: Touch
chapters.summary: Silas and Vespera's alternating POV. A quiet chapter: wounded after the riot, the two confess love without ceremony, trading memories deliberately for the first time—gifts, not thefts. Emotional beat: tenderness as resistance.

chapters.title: Ilsette's Brother
chapters.summary: Warden Ilsette's POV. She interrogates a captured Silas and, in the struggle, Silas accidentally returns her suppressed memory of her brother's branding. Shaken, she lets them escape—or believes she does. Emotional beat: the lawbreaker inside the lawmaker wakes.

chapters.title: Escape from the Salt House
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. A brutal breakout through the guild's flooded cellars, aided by smugglers and Odile. Corvane, half-mad, tries to burn the ledgers with everyone inside; Silas saves the book of the hunted instead of the guild's wealth. Emotional beat: values proven under fire.

chapters.title: The Road of Double Shadows
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. The refugee column crosses the glass steppe under the twelfth moon's waning, hunted by Ilsette's reformed wardens. Neme's gift—remembering things that haven't happened yet—guides them past ambushes. Emotional beat: weary solidarity.

chapters.title: Neme's Tomorrow
chapters.summary: Neme's POV. The child foresees the Door opening onto nothing unless someone carries the country's founding memory—and sees Silas dying to provide it. Neme tells no one. Emotional beat: dread carried in small hands.

chapters.title: Corvane's Last Entry
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. Dying of his brand, he crawls to Silas's camp and begs not for mercy but to have his original memories returned—he hid them in the ledger decades ago. Silas restores them; he weeps, names the Door's true key, and dies himself again. Emotional beat: redemption too late, but not worthless.

chapters.title: The Key Was Never a Thing
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Corvane's restored memory reveals the Door opens to a freely surrendered memory of the country, given up forever—not carried. Whoever opens it loses the Steppe from their mind permanently. Emotional beat: the choice crystallizing into sacrifice.

chapters.title: Ilsette's Choice
chapters.summary: Warden Ilsette's POV. At the Door's threshold with her wardens, she receives orders to seal it with the refugees inside. Remembering her brother, she arrests her own second-in-command instead and holds the pass open. Emotional beat: the law bent toward justice.

chapters.title: Moon Thirteen
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. The thirteenth moon rises full and doubled. The Door of Salt shimmers open on the ridge—but the key requires a memory now, and the crowd of hundreds falls silent, each unwilling, each unable. Emotional beat: terrible stillness before sacrifice.

chapters.title: What Silas Gives Away
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Silas walks to the Door and surrenders every memory of the Salt Steppe—their grandmother, the lullaby, their own name's origin—as the key. The Door widens for all. They cross knowing they will never know why this place mattered. Emotional beat: grief and liberation in one breath.

chapters.title: The Country Beyond
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. On the far side: a living land the maps never held, where the freed memories of the riot have already taken root as shared recollection. Vespera begins drawing the first new map. Silas stands beside her, a stranger to their own story. Emotional beat: wonder shadowed by loss.

chapters.title: Remembered by Others
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The refugees gather and give Silas back their history piece by piece—each donating a memory of them, since memory freely given can be returned. It is imperfect, patchwork, theirs. Emotional beat: community as authorship of a self.

chapters.title: Ilsette's Report
chapters.summary: Warden Ilsette's POV. Back in the capital, she files a report declaring the Door a myth and the Steppe empty, protecting the exiles with an official lie. She keeps her brother's brand-token on her desk. Emotional beat: justice wearing the law's uniform.

chapters.title: The New Ledger
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Silas founds a different kind of archive in the new country: a ledger of memories freely given and freely returnable, with Vespera as its first witness. No theft, no debt. Emotional beat: vocation transformed.

chapters.title: Neme's Tomorrow, Revised
chapters.summary: Neme's POV. The child's foresight shifts—futures bend around what Silas chose. Neme sees a long life ahead for the settlement, and one more door, far off, that may someday need opening. Seeds a wider world. Emotional beat: hope with horizons.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Oath
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. Vespera formally swears her new map to no crown, completing her arc from servant of empire to maker of countries. She and Silas speak plainly of love at last, unhidden. Emotional beat: arrival, both geographic and personal.

chapters.title: Salt and Glass
chapters.summary: Silas's POV, final. Standing on the ridge at moonrise, Silas touches the salt air and feels, faintly, a memory that isn't theirs returning on the wind—the country forgiving them. They walk down to the lights of the settlement. Emotional beat: peace earned, story closed.

chapters.title: Epilogue: The Thirteenth Turn
chapters.summary: Omniscient coda. Years later, a traveler brings news: the old kingdom has fallen, and hunters once feared are now historians begging at the Door. Inside the new country, Silas adds a final line to the ledger: 'All debts remembered, none collected.' Emotional beat: quiet triumph of memory over erasure.
